docs.title: ChatECNU 文档
docs.text:
ChatECNU 提供 ECNU 门户和校园网联网的 Python API 与命令行工具。日常命令主推 ecnu。

  • 门户

    登录门户、查看首页摘要、会话状态和用户信息。

    ecnu home ...

  • 校园网联网

    使用 PyPI 包内置的 Linux x86_64 auth_client，检查、登录、退出或确保本机在线。

    ecnu net ...

  • 访客账号

    管理 ECNU 访客账号，修改类命令支持预演。

    ecnu visitor ...

  • ChatEnv 配置

    使用 ecnu 类型保存账号、密码和本机联网配置；门户会话写入 runtime token-store。

    查看变量

docs.title: 边界
docs.text:
• 门户登录不是校园网联网；它只管理 ECNU 门户会话。
  • net 不是门户登录；它只管理本机校园网出口认证。
  • 默认 ECNU_NETWORK_BACKEND=python：直接执行 SRun HTTP 协议，不运行 auth_client，不通过外部进程 argv 传密码。复用 ChatEnv 的 ECNU_USERNAME / ECNU_PASSWORD 及原生 ECNU_NETWORK_BASE_URL / ECNU_NETWORK_AC_ID；Python 仅在显式 --setting-file 时导入旧格式；登录/退出后重新检查实际在线状态，JSON 返回 backend=python。只有显式选择 ECNU_NETWORK_BACKEND=binary 才使用旧二进制，且登录仍需 --allow-argv-password；--auth-client / ECNU_AUTH_CLIENT 也仅作用于 binary。默认 Python 路径不需要 net install。
  • stdout、stderr、JSON 输出和 redacted command 都会脱敏已解析密码。
  • 门户会话、Cookie、CSRF 这类动态状态写入 tokens/ECNU/<profile>.json，不写入 ECNU_COOKIE stable env 字段。
  • 进程环境优先于默认 ChatEnv；显式 -e / --env-file 才使用指定配置。

docs.title: 验证入口
docs.text:
python -m pytest -q
mkdocs build --strict
ecnu net check --json

docs.title: ChatEnv 变量
docs.text: ChatECNU 注册的 ChatEnv 类型是 ecnu。门户和校园网共用同一个 ECNU 账号密码，不拆两套变量。稳定配置保存在 ~/.chatarch/envs/ECNU/<profile>.env；门户 Web/API 会话、Cookie 和 CSRF 等动态状态保存在 ChatEnv runtime token-store：~/.chatarch/tokens/ECNU/<profile>.json。

docs.title: 常用命令
docs.text:
chatenv list
chatenv init -t ecnu -I

-e/--env 只选择本次命令使用的 ChatEnv profile，不切换全局 active profile。显式 profile 内的值优先，避免不同账号串用。

ecnu net install 通过 EnvStore 只更新 ECNU_AUTH_CLIENT 和 ECNU_AUTH_SETTING_FILE，保留其他已存值。不带 -e 更新 active envs/ECNU/.env；ecnu -e campus net install 只写 envs/ECNU/campus.env，active 不变，不回填进程环境凭据。--dry-run 不写 profile；安装器不接受隐藏的 --env-file override。

docs.title: 变量
docs.text: 变量 用途 敏感 ECNU_USERNAME 门户和校园网共用用户名 否 ECNU_PASSWORD 门户和校园网共用密码 是 ECNU_BASE_URL 门户基地址 否 ECNU_NETWORK_BASE_URL 校园网认证基地址，默认 https://login.ecnu.edu.cn，不同于门户管理地址 否 ECNU_NETWORK_AC_ID 校园网AC ID，默认 1 否 ECNU_NETWORK_BACKEND 默认 python；显式 binary 才用兼容二进制 否 ECNU_AUTH_CLIENT binary 后端可选二进制路径 否 ECNU_AUTH_SETTING_FILE binary 设置文件；默认 Python 不读取 否 ECNU_VISITOR_PASSWORD1 默认访客账号一密码 是 ECNU_VISITOR_PASSWORD2 默认访客账号二密码 是 ECNU_VISITOR_REMARK 默认访客备注 否

docs.title: 使用示例
docs.text:
ecnu -e default home status
chatenv token status -s ECNU -p default
chatenv token refresh ECNU default
ecnu -e default net check --json
ecnu -e default visitor default -I

chatenv token refresh ECNU <profile> 使用同名 stable env profile 中的 ECNU_USERNAME / ECNU_PASSWORD 运行一次非交互 OCR 自动登录，并由 ChatEnv 写入 runtime token-store。若门户要求短信验证码或所有验证码候选失败，该 refresh 会安全失败；需要先用 ecnu -e <profile> home login ... 完成交互式登录。

docs.title: 命令树
docs.text: 这页只列当前已实现的可见命令。隐藏诊断命令不放进主树。能力边界见 能力地图，Python 映射见 接口树。

docs.title: 当前可见命令树
docs.text:
以下内容来自 ecnu --tree 的当前 Click 注册表输出，默认包含参数签名；ecnu --tree-brief 保留命令节点和说明，但省略参数签名：

ecnu
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
├── --env ENV-PROFILE  # ChatEnv 配置名。
├── home  # ECNU 门户。
│   ├── info [--json]  # 门户首页摘要。
│   ├── login [--username USERNAME] [--password PASSWORD] [--sms-code SMS-CODE] [--json] [--interactive]  # 登录门户。
│   ├── logout [--json]  # 退出门户会话。
│   ├── status [--json]  # 门户会话状态。
│   └── user [--json]  # 门户用户信息。
├── net  # 校园网联网。
│   ├── check [--auth-client AUTH-CLIENT-PATH] [--setting-file SETTING-FILE] [--json]  # 检查在线状态。
│   ├── ensure-login [--auth-client AUTH-CLIENT-PATH] [--setting-file SETTING-FILE] [--username USERNAME] [--password PASSWORD] [--allow-argv-password] [--json] [--interactive]  # 离线时登录。
│   ├── install [--host HOST] [--ac-id AC-ID] [--campus-url CAMPUS-URL] [--campus-postfix CAMPUS-POSTFIX] [--force] [--dry-run] [--json]  # 离线准备联网工具与设置，不登录。
│   ├── login [--auth-client AUTH-CLIENT-PATH] [--setting-file SETTING-FILE] [--username USERNAME] [--password PASSWORD] [--allow-argv-password] [--json] [--interactive]  # 登录。
│   └── logout [--auth-client AUTH-CLIENT-PATH] [--setting-file SETTING-FILE] [--username USERNAME] [--json] [--interactive]  # 退出校园网。
└── visitor  # 访客账号。
    ├── create [--remark REMARK] [--dry-run] [--json] [--interactive]  # 创建访客账号。
    ├── default [--password1 PASSWORD1] [--password2 PASSWORD2] [--remark REMARK] [--json] [--interactive]  # 维护默认访客账号。
    ├── delete [--id VISITOR-ID] [--dry-run] [--json] [--interactive]  # 删除访客账号。
    ├── get [--id VISITOR-ID] [--account ACCOUNT] [--json]  # 查询访客账号。
    ├── list [--json]  # 列出访客账号。
    └── update [--id VISITOR-ID] [--remark REMARK] [--password PASSWORD] [--dry-run] [--json] [--interactive]  # 更新访客备注和密码。

chatecnu 命令作为兼容别名保留，与 ecnu 共享同一入口；两个入口的命令树都固定以规范名 ecnu 为根。

隐藏的 debug、selftest、home login-init/login-auto/session-info 和 visitor lock 仍保留给诊断/内部流程，不作为主用户树展示；home cookie-header 为避免 raw Cookie 泄漏已禁用。

docs.title: ECNU 使用
docs.text: ChatECNU 把 ECNU 相关能力分成三组：home 管门户，net 管校园网联网，visitor 管访客账号。

docs.title: 门户
docs.text:
门户登录建立 ECNU Web/API 会话，供首页摘要、用户信息和访客账号接口使用。 会话默认保存到 ChatEnv token-store：~/.chatarch/tokens/ECNU/<profile>.json；ecnu home status --json 只输出 Cookie 数量、token 文件、profile 等安全摘要，不输出原始 Cookie/CSRF。也可以用 chatenv token refresh ECNU <profile> 从同名 stable env profile 发起非交互 OCR 自动登录；遇到短信验证码或验证码候选失败时会安全失败。

ecnu home login --rounds 3 --topk 5 -I
ecnu home info
ecnu home status
ecnu home user
ecnu home logout

短信验证码：

ecnu home login --sms-code 123456 --rounds 3 --topk 5 -I

手动验证码流程保留为隐藏 helper：

ecnu home login-init
ecnu home login --captcha ABCD -I

docs.title: 显式准备校园网工具
docs.text:
pip install 不会改用户文件。默认 Python 后端无需安装 auth_client；下面的显式离线安装器只准备 Linux x86_64 binary 兼容后端：

ecnu net install --dry-run --json
ecnu net install --json
# 只更新指定 ChatEnv profile，不激活它：
ecnu -e campus net install --json
# 新配置可定制认证端点；不要传账号、密码或 token：
ecnu net install --host login.ecnu.edu.cn --ac-id 1 --campus-url "" --campus-postfix ""

实体默认在 $CHATARCH_HOME/chatecnu/（未设置时 ~/.chatarch/chatecnu/）：bin/auth_client、config/auth-setting.toml；兼容入口为 ~/.local/bin/auth_client、~/.auth-setting 薄链接。既有可用 legacy 文件会原样保留并被选用，不迁移、不覆盖；重复安装不重写。端点选项只影响新生成的设置；修改既有设置须显式 --force。替换前原文件/链接备份到 chatecnu/backups/<id>/，未知链接目标不修改；目录冲突始终失败。

--dry-run 连目录和 ChatEnv profile 都不创建；--json 回读路径、来源与动作，不输出 profile 值。只通过 EnvStore 更新 ECNU_AUTH_CLIENT / ECNU_AUTH_SETTING_FILE，保留凭据和其他值。安装器不登录、不重启、不安装 daemon、无下载；Mac、Windows、Linux ARM 在写入前失败（包括 dry-run）。

docs.title: 校园网联网
docs.text:
默认 ECNU_NETWORK_BACKEND=python：直接执行 SRun HTTP 协议，不运行 auth_client，不通过外部进程 argv 传密码。复用 ChatEnv 的 ECNU_USERNAME / ECNU_PASSWORD 及原生 ECNU_NETWORK_BASE_URL / ECNU_NETWORK_AC_ID；Python 仅在显式 --setting-file 时导入旧格式；登录/退出后重新检查实际在线状态，JSON 返回 backend=python。只有显式选择 ECNU_NETWORK_BACKEND=binary 才使用旧二进制，且登录仍需 --allow-argv-password；--auth-client / ECNU_AUTH_CLIENT 也仅作用于 binary。默认 Python 路径不需要 net install。

ecnu net check --json
ecnu net login -I
ecnu net logout -I
ecnu net ensure-login -I

默认 ECNU_NETWORK_BACKEND=python：直接执行 SRun HTTP 协议，不运行 auth_client，不通过外部进程 argv 传密码。复用 ChatEnv 的 ECNU_USERNAME / ECNU_PASSWORD 及原生 ECNU_NETWORK_BASE_URL / ECNU_NETWORK_AC_ID；Python 仅在显式 --setting-file 时导入旧格式；登录/退出后重新检查实际在线状态，JSON 返回 backend=python。只有显式选择 ECNU_NETWORK_BACKEND=binary 才使用旧二进制，且登录仍需 --allow-argv-password；--auth-client / ECNU_AUTH_CLIENT 也仅作用于 binary。默认 Python 路径不需要 net install。

新生成设置只有以下四个 TOML 字段，不含凭据：

host = "login.ecnu.edu.cn"
acid = 1
campus_url = ""
campus_postfix = ""

安装后 wrapper 会读取 installer 写入的 ECNU_AUTH_SETTING_FILE，并向 helper 传 -c。--host 接受主机名或 IPv4（可带端口，不含 scheme/path/userinfo）；--ac-id 为正整数。可用既有设置需要合法 TOML 和这四个字段。--force --dry-run --json 可预览备份/替换计划；确认后去掉 --dry-run。备份不会自动还原；系统 I/O 失败可能留下部分文件，可检查 JSON/路径后重试。

docs.title: 访客账号
docs.text:
ecnu visitor list
ecnu visitor get --id 10256703
ecnu visitor create --remark GuestA --dry-run -I
ecnu visitor default -I

修改类命令支持 --dry-run。

docs.title: 包结构
docs.text:
chatecnu
├── cli.main                 # Click 入口；安装后提供 ecnu 与兼容别名 chatecnu
├── config.ECNUConfig        # ChatEnv ecnu 类型
├── ecnu.session_tokens      # ECNU 门户会话的 ChatEnv token-store adapter

├── network_install          # 离线 helper/config 安装器
└── ecnu.portal              # ECNU 门户客户端

docs.text: Python 接口 命令行映射 chatstyle.add_tree_option() ecnu --tree / ecnu --tree-brief PortalClient.login_init() ecnu home login-init（隐藏） PortalClient.login() / login_auto() ecnu home login PortalClient.logout() ecnu home logout PortalClient.home_summary() ecnu home info PortalClient.user_info() ecnu home user PortalClient.auth_logs() / detail_logs() ecnu debug ...（隐藏） chatecnu.network_install.install_network_auth() ecnu net install chatecnu.network_install.state_paths() 安装 JSON 的实体/兼容路径回读 NetworkAuthClient.check() ecnu net check NetworkAuthClient.login() ecnu net login NetworkAuthClient.logout() / logout_current() ecnu net logout NetworkAuthClient.ensure_login() ecnu net ensure-login PortalClient.list_visitors() ecnu visitor list PortalClient.get_visitor() ecnu visitor get PortalClient.create_visitor() ecnu visitor create PortalClient.update_visitor() ecnu visitor update PortalClient.delete_visitor() ecnu visitor delete

docs.title: 安装器 Python API
docs.text:
from chatecnu.network_install import install_network_auth, state_paths

paths = state_paths()  # 不写入，使用 ChatEnv get_paths().home_dir。
plan = install_network_auth(dry_run=True, env_profile="campus")
print(plan.to_dict())  # 只含路径与动作，不含 profile 值。

API 全部为 keyword-only 参数：home（ChatArch 根）、user_home（legacy 入口根）、env_profile、host、ac_id、campus_url、campus_postfix、force、dry_run。返回 NetworkInstallResult；平台、设置和路径冲突抛出 NetworkInstallError，系统 I/O 错误可能直接抛出。dry-run 也要求 native Linux x86_64；不会运行 helper。

docs.title: ChatECNU Documentation
docs.text:
ChatECNU provides Python APIs and command-line tools for ECNU portal access and campus-network access. The daily command is ecnu.

  • Portal

    Login, read the portal home summary, inspect session state, and read user info.

    ecnu home ...

  • Campus network

    Use the PyPI-bundled Linux x86_64 auth_client to check, login, logout, or ensure local network access.

    ecnu net ...

  • Visitor accounts

    Manage ECNU visitor accounts with dry-run support for mutations.

    ecnu visitor ...

  • ChatEnv config

    Store credentials and local network settings under the ecnu type; portal sessions go to the runtime token store.

    View variables

docs.title: Current Capabilities
docs.text: Capability Status Entry Boundary Portal login Implemented ecnu home login Creates an ECNU Web/API session Portal reads Implemented ecnu home info/status/user Requires a logged-in portal session in the token store Visitor accounts Implemented ecnu visitor ... Mutation commands support --dry-run Offline network setup Implemented ecnu net install Native Linux x86_64; no login/download; dry-run and backed-up force Network check Implemented ecnu net check Does not need a password Campus network access Implemented ecnu net login/logout/ensure-login Native Python HTTP by default; explicit binary compatibility only ChatEnv config Implemented ecnu type Passwords live in stable env; portal sessions/cookies live in the runtime token store

docs.title: Boundaries
docs.text:
• Portal login is not campus-network access; it only manages the ECNU portal session.
  • net is not portal login; it only manages local campus-network access.
  • ECNU_NETWORK_BACKEND=python is the default: SRun HTTP runs directly, without auth_client or password-bearing child-process argv. It reuses ChatEnv ECNU_USERNAME / ECNU_PASSWORD and native ECNU_NETWORK_BASE_URL / ECNU_NETWORK_AC_ID; Python imports legacy settings only with explicit --setting-file; login/logout verify the resulting online state and JSON reports backend=python. Only explicit ECNU_NETWORK_BACKEND=binary uses the legacy binary, where login still requires --allow-argv-password; --auth-client / ECNU_AUTH_CLIENT apply only to binary. The default Python path does not require net install.
  • stdout, stderr, JSON payloads, and redacted commands mask resolved passwords.
  • Portal sessions, cookies, and CSRF state are written to tokens/ECNU/<profile>.json, not to a stable ECNU_COOKIE env field.
  • Process env wins over default ChatEnv; explicit -e / --env-file selects a specific config.

docs.title: Verification Entry Points
docs.text:
python -m pytest -q
mkdocs build --strict
ecnu net check --json

docs.title: ChatEnv Variables
docs.text: ChatECNU registers the ChatEnv type ecnu. Portal access and campus-network access share the same ECNU username and password. Stable configuration is stored in ~/.chatarch/envs/ECNU/<profile>.env; dynamic portal Web/API session state, cookies, and CSRF payloads are stored in ChatEnv's runtime token store at ~/.chatarch/tokens/ECNU/<profile>.json.

docs.title: Common Commands
docs.text:
chatenv list
chatenv init -t ecnu -I

-e/--env selects a ChatEnv profile for the current command without switching the global active profile. Explicit profile values take precedence to avoid cross-account leakage.

ecnu net install updates only ECNU_AUTH_CLIENT and ECNU_AUTH_SETTING_FILE through EnvStore, retaining every other stored value. Without -e, it updates the active envs/ECNU/.env; with ecnu -e campus net install, only envs/ECNU/campus.env changes and the active file stays untouched. Process credentials are not backfilled. --dry-run performs no profile writes. The hidden --env-file override is not accepted by the installer.

docs.title: Variables
docs.text: Variable Purpose Sensitive ECNU_USERNAME Shared portal and network username No ECNU_PASSWORD Shared portal and network password Yes ECNU_BASE_URL Portal base URL No ECNU_NETWORK_BASE_URL Network portal base URL; default https://login.ecnu.edu.cn No ECNU_NETWORK_AC_ID Network AC ID; default 1 No ECNU_NETWORK_BACKEND python (default) or explicit binary compatibility No ECNU_AUTH_CLIENT Binary-backend executable override No ECNU_AUTH_SETTING_FILE Binary backend setting file; ignored by default Python No ECNU_VISITOR_PASSWORD1 First default visitor password Yes ECNU_VISITOR_PASSWORD2 Second default visitor password Yes ECNU_VISITOR_REMARK Default visitor remark No

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
ecnu -e default home status
chatenv token status -s ECNU -p default
chatenv token refresh ECNU default
ecnu -e default net check --json
ecnu -e default visitor default -I

chatenv token refresh ECNU <profile> runs one non-interactive OCR-backed auto-login using ECNU_USERNAME / ECNU_PASSWORD from the matching stable env profile, then lets ChatEnv write the runtime token-store record. It fails closed when the portal requires SMS verification or rejects all CAPTCHA candidates; use ecnu -e <profile> home login ... first for interactive login.

docs.title: CLI Tree
docs.text: This page lists only visible implemented commands. Hidden diagnostics are not part of the main user tree. See Capability Map for boundaries and Interface Tree for Python mappings.

docs.title: Current Visible Command Tree
docs.text:
The following tree comes from the current Click registry and can be read back with ecnu --tree, which includes parameter signatures by default. ecnu --tree-brief keeps command nodes and descriptions while omitting parameter signatures:

ecnu
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
├── --env ENV-PROFILE  # ChatEnv 配置名。
├── home  # ECNU 门户。
│   ├── info [--json]  # 门户首页摘要。
│   ├── login [--username USERNAME] [--password PASSWORD] [--sms-code SMS-CODE] [--json] [--interactive]  # 登录门户。
│   ├── logout [--json]  # 退出门户会话。
│   ├── status [--json]  # 门户会话状态。
│   └── user [--json]  # 门户用户信息。
├── net  # 校园网联网。
│   ├── check [--auth-client AUTH-CLIENT-PATH] [--setting-file SETTING-FILE] [--json]  # 检查在线状态。
│   ├── ensure-login [--auth-client AUTH-CLIENT-PATH] [--setting-file SETTING-FILE] [--username USERNAME] [--password PASSWORD] [--allow-argv-password] [--json] [--interactive]  # 离线时登录。
│   ├── install [--host HOST] [--ac-id AC-ID] [--campus-url CAMPUS-URL] [--campus-postfix CAMPUS-POSTFIX] [--force] [--dry-run] [--json]  # 离线准备联网工具与设置，不登录。
│   ├── login [--auth-client AUTH-CLIENT-PATH] [--setting-file SETTING-FILE] [--username USERNAME] [--password PASSWORD] [--allow-argv-password] [--json] [--interactive]  # 登录。
│   └── logout [--auth-client AUTH-CLIENT-PATH] [--setting-file SETTING-FILE] [--username USERNAME] [--json] [--interactive]  # 退出校园网。
└── visitor  # 访客账号。
    ├── create [--remark REMARK] [--dry-run] [--json] [--interactive]  # 创建访客账号。
    ├── default [--password1 PASSWORD1] [--password2 PASSWORD2] [--remark REMARK] [--json] [--interactive]  # 维护默认访客账号。
    ├── delete [--id VISITOR-ID] [--dry-run] [--json] [--interactive]  # 删除访客账号。
    ├── get [--id VISITOR-ID] [--account ACCOUNT] [--json]  # 查询访客账号。
    ├── list [--json]  # 列出访客账号。
    └── update [--id VISITOR-ID] [--remark REMARK] [--password PASSWORD] [--dry-run] [--json] [--interactive]  # 更新访客备注和密码。

The chatecnu command remains a compatibility alias and shares the same entry point as ecnu; both trees use the canonical ecnu root.

Hidden debug, selftest, home login-init/login-auto/session-info, and visitor lock entries remain available for diagnostics/internal flows, but are not part of the main user tree. home cookie-header is disabled to avoid raw cookie leaks.

docs.title: ECNU Usage
docs.text: ChatECNU splits ECNU capabilities into three groups: home for portal access, net for campus-network access, and visitor for visitor accounts.

docs.title: Portal
docs.text:
Portal login creates an ECNU Web/API session used by home summary, user info, and visitor-account APIs. Sessions are stored in ChatEnv's runtime token store by default: ~/.chatarch/tokens/ECNU/<profile>.json. ecnu home status --json returns only safe metadata such as cookie count, token file, and profile; it never prints raw cookies or CSRF values. chatenv token refresh ECNU <profile> can run a non-interactive OCR-backed auto-login from the matching stable env profile and fails closed when SMS or CAPTCHA retries are required.

ecnu home login --rounds 3 --topk 5 -I
ecnu home info
ecnu home status
ecnu home user
ecnu home logout

SMS code flow:

ecnu home login --sms-code 123456 --rounds 3 --topk 5 -I

Manual CAPTCHA helpers remain hidden:

ecnu home login-init
ecnu home login --captcha ABCD -I

docs.title: Explicit campus-network setup
docs.text:
pip install does not modify user files. The default Python backend needs no auth_client installation. The following explicit offline installer prepares only the Linux x86_64 binary compatibility backend:

ecnu net install --dry-run --json
ecnu net install --json
# Update only this ChatEnv profile without activating it:
ecnu -e campus net install --json
# Customize a new endpoint configuration; never pass credentials or tokens:
ecnu net install --host login.ecnu.edu.cn --ac-id 1 --campus-url "" --campus-postfix ""

Managed files default to $CHATARCH_HOME/chatecnu/ (~/.chatarch/chatecnu/ when unset): bin/auth_client and config/auth-setting.toml. The legacy entries ~/.local/bin/auth_client and ~/.auth-setting are thin symlinks. Usable existing legacy files are preserved byte-for-byte and selected as-is, never relocated; repeated installation does not rewrite files. Endpoint options affect newly generated settings only; replacing existing settings requires explicit --force. Replaced files/symlinks are backed up under chatecnu/backups/<id>/; unknown symlink targets stay untouched, and directory conflicts always fail.

--dry-run creates no directories or ChatEnv profiles. --json reads back paths, sources and actions, not profile values. Only ECNU_AUTH_CLIENT / ECNU_AUTH_SETTING_FILE are updated through EnvStore; credentials and other values are preserved. No login, restart, daemon installation or download occurs. Mac, Windows and Linux ARM fail before writes, including dry-run.

docs.title: Campus network access
docs.text:
ECNU_NETWORK_BACKEND=python is the default: SRun HTTP runs directly, without auth_client or password-bearing child-process argv. It reuses ChatEnv ECNU_USERNAME / ECNU_PASSWORD and native ECNU_NETWORK_BASE_URL / ECNU_NETWORK_AC_ID; Python imports legacy settings only with explicit --setting-file; login/logout verify the resulting online state and JSON reports backend=python. Only explicit ECNU_NETWORK_BACKEND=binary uses the legacy binary, where login still requires --allow-argv-password; --auth-client / ECNU_AUTH_CLIENT apply only to binary. The default Python path does not require net install.

ecnu net check --json
ecnu net login -I
ecnu net logout -I
ecnu net ensure-login -I

ECNU_NETWORK_BACKEND=python is the default: SRun HTTP runs directly, without auth_client or password-bearing child-process argv. It reuses ChatEnv ECNU_USERNAME / ECNU_PASSWORD and native ECNU_NETWORK_BASE_URL / ECNU_NETWORK_AC_ID; Python imports legacy settings only with explicit --setting-file; login/logout verify the resulting online state and JSON reports backend=python. Only explicit ECNU_NETWORK_BACKEND=binary uses the legacy binary, where login still requires --allow-argv-password; --auth-client / ECNU_AUTH_CLIENT apply only to binary. The default Python path does not require net install.

New settings contain only these four TOML fields, with no credentials:

host = "login.ecnu.edu.cn"
acid = 1
campus_url = ""
campus_postfix = ""

After installation, the wrapper reads the installer-configured ECNU_AUTH_SETTING_FILE and passes -c to the helper. --host accepts a hostname or IPv4 with an optional port, not a scheme/path/userinfo; --ac-id is a positive integer. Usable existing settings must be valid TOML containing all four fields. Preview backups/replacements with --force --dry-run --json, then remove --dry-run after review. Backups are not automatically restored. OS-level I/O failures can leave partial files; inspect paths/actions and retry safely.

docs.title: Visitor accounts
docs.text:
ecnu visitor list
ecnu visitor get --id 10256703
ecnu visitor create --remark GuestA --dry-run -I
ecnu visitor default -I

Mutation commands support --dry-run.

docs.title: Installer Python API
docs.text:
from chatecnu.network_install import install_network_auth, state_paths

paths = state_paths()  # No writes; uses ChatEnv get_paths().home_dir.
plan = install_network_auth(dry_run=True, env_profile="campus")
print(plan.to_dict())  # Paths/actions only, never profile values.

The keyword-only API accepts home (ChatArch home), user_home (legacy entrypoints), env_profile, host, ac_id, campus_url, campus_postfix, force and dry_run. Returns NetworkInstallResult; NetworkInstallError reports platform/settings/path errors and OS errors may propagate. Native Linux x86_64 is required even for planning. It never executes the helper.

docs.title: ChatEnv Interface
docs.text: See ChatEnv Variables for the full schema. Stable sensitive fields are managed by ChatEnv profiles; portal cookie/CSRF session state is managed by ChatEnv's token store, and command output shows only safe metadata.

docs.title: Install
